DYNASTIC_MERCHANT.name: Dynastic Merchant Magnate
DYNASTIC_MERCHANT.description: Amass considerable personal fortune and commercial volume to secure a generational legacy.

MASTER_ARTISAN.name: Guildmaster of the Trade
MASTER_ARTISAN.description: Attain pinnacle vocational skill, craft exemplary masterpieces, and mentor the next generation.

CIVIC_PATRICIAN.name: Civic Statesman & Council Leader
CIVIC_PATRICIAN.description: Lead the municipal council, enact protective ordinances, and maintain spotless civic honor.

DEVOTED_SPOUSE.name: Devoted Spouse & Homestead Guardian
DEVOTED_SPOUSE.description: Cultivate sustained marital harmony, regular intimacy, deep affection (>= 70), and protect the household from grief and domestic distress.

PILLAR_OF_THE_COMMUNITY.name: Pillar of the Community
PILLAR_OF_THE_COMMUNITY.description: Maintain an unblemished civic standing (>= 70.0), active mutual aid lodge support, moral piety, and communal harmony.

OUTLAW_KINGPIN.name: Underworld Shadow Boss
OUTLAW_KINGPIN.description: Rule the clandestine night market, pulling strings in taverns and evading the Town Watch.
